name: NGC 1827 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 1827, an edge-on spiral galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc1827-hubble
story: We see this spiral galaxy edge-on, its disk threaded with dust lanes where new stars are likely forming. Hubble took it during a survey of satellite galaxies around Milky Way-like galaxies.

claims.text: NGC 1827 is an edge-on, intermediate spiral galaxy
NGC 1827 is in the constellation Columba
Its disk has dust lanes where new stars are likely forming
The image was taken for a survey of satellite galaxies around Milky Way-like hosts
NGC 1827 is a target of program 18061, Hubble Census of Nearby Satellites
